item.title: Seeking Greenlight!
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Sci-Fi

Elevator Pitch: A cave Approximately 1.2 yards wide when looked outside.
- It seems to have a more stronger gravitational pull Than earth
- The cause of it's gravitational pull isn't yet discovered.
- It seems to get wider and deeper as you travel more, making it hard for someone to go back.

Central Narrative: An anomalous cave that has a different Gravitational Pull than earth. It has a more stronger pull inside the cave. The cave's gravitational pull gets stronger as it gets deeper.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: A cave with gravitational pull stronger than earth, and get's wider and deeper making it harder and more confusing to get out.
